top_signals.title: Stocks Fall and Treasury Rally Fades as Oil Climbs: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: A rebound in long-dated Treasuries faded and US stock futures fell as rising oil prices put inflation risks back on investors’ radar.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Treasury yields rebound, wiping out the decline following Bessent's intervention
top_signals.summary: Bond yields edged higher after pulling back sharply during Wednesday's session.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: CBP finds $15M in meth hidden in celery load at Pharr, Texas, border crossing
top_signals.summary:
A tractor-trailer arrived from Mexico carrying fresh produce before inspection technology detected anomalies. Officers ultimately seized 1,675.5 pounds of methamphetamine.
